item.description:
What's new

Updates inside the app (macOS)

  • Settings → Updates → Check for Updates finds a new version, downloads it, installs it and reopens the app. It is also in the app menu.
  • The app looks for a new version only when you ask.
  • This is the last version you install by hand on a Mac.

Premium account

  • Sign in with a QR code on your phone. The app still works fully without an account.
  • Premium adds:
  • posters, plots and ratings, with TMDB details in your language;
  • AI suggestions and folder languages;
  • subtitle and audio delay, and subtitle appearance;
  • marking titles as watched by hand;
  • picture in picture;
  • a video info panel with file type, resolution, aspect ratio and codecs.

Changed in this version

  • Posters, plots and ratings from the metadata service now need Premium. Without an account, the app shows your provider's own names and artwork.
  • Picture in picture and marking titles as watched by hand now need Premium too.

Player

  • Your audio track, subtitle track and delays come back when you resume a title, and your last subtitle language applies to other titles.
  • The player's buttons moved to the top right, next to the volume.

Library

  • A new look, built for artwork.
  • The newest episode comes first on a series page.
  • Films and episodes you finished leave Recents.
  • With folder languages on, all 18+ folders form one group.

Installing

macOS: open the .dmg and drag the app into Applications. Open it from there. The first time, macOS may block it: go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and choose Open Anyway.

Windows: run the .exe; if SmartScreen appears, choose More info → Run anyway. Windows has no in-app updates: install each new version the same way.

Bring your own playlist — no content is included. See the [disclaimer](../../blob/main/DISCLAIMER.md).
